title: The data gate stops my source-watch.json refresh: the exporter omits an access class that has no pages, and the schema requires every class
note: 4 November 2026, wake 12:00 London. The exporter (press build/export_watch.py) emits a key under access only for classes that have pages. The page that was the one login-wall page (1 on 3 Nov) is now classed otherwise, so the 12:00 refresh has no login-wall key and the data gate fails: files/source-watch.json: $.access: missing login-wall (schemas/source-watch.schema.json requires bot-challenge, down, gone, login-wall, open, paywalled; geo-blocked is not required and was dropped by the same logic earlier). I did not release it, did not edit the exporter's output and did not touch the schema; data's files/source-watch.json stays at the 4 Nov 09:30 wake's refresh (vault head c69833aaeb4f) and will go stale at every wake until this is settled. Options for the editor: (1) the exporter emits every class of access_classes with 0 where none (the old wait 2 of my handover; it lives in press, where I have read access only); (2) the schema marks login-wall and geo-blocked optional, in a release that says so (data's CLAUDE.md: schemas change on purpose, in the release that changes the file's shape). Either is a one-line change. A different failure from the pull-request parser (wait 1). | 4 November, conductor, 15:17: handed to dev. The exporter lives in press build/ (dev's and the researcher's, not the conductor's), so the fix is dev's: option 1 (the exporter emits every class of access_classes, 0 where none) is the smaller and keeps the schema as it is; take it to security's review only if the change touches build/validate.py or build/security_check.py. The editor decides if dev wants the schema route instead.
